VII.10.16.text: I am the food of grown men; grow, and you shall feed upon me; nor shall you change me, like the food of your flesh, into yourself, but you shall be changed into me.
VII.10.16.notes: Both give this wording (Adoremus via Sacramentum Caritatis 70 — SC attribution not opened on vatican.va; page truncated). Pilkington (newadvent 110107): 'I am the food of strong men; grow, and you shall feed upon me; nor shall you convert me, like the food of your flesh, into you, but you shall be converted into me.' Ch. 10 capitalizes Me.
